name: PR Overview shows the Blast radius card (stats, or a degraded notice with Resync)
description: PR #482 → Overview tab (the default): the Blast radius card renders its stat row read from GET /pulls/:id/blast. Whether the seeded repo has a repo-intel index depends on the stack (flag, indexing), so the flow asserts what both outcomes share: the card and its stat row (read from the card's own innerText: the 'callers' label exists only there). A degraded read additionally shows the 'Degraded' notice with Resync; that is not asserted because it is stack-dependent. Read-only (no model call). The PR list defaults to 'Needs review', which flows 09/11 make it fail (PR now 'reviewed'), so this flow clicks 'All' first, like flows 10/11/12.
